Pokweegee Marauder
CR 14

A blur of tan quills streaks across the battlefield, its reptilian face locked in a perpetual grin as it darts between opponents with impossible speed.

XP 38,400
Pokweegee marauder 15
CN Medium humanoid (extraplanar)
Init +9; Senses Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 21, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +5 natural, +5 dodge, +1 deflection)
hp 135 (15d10+45)
Fort +9, Ref +16, Will +9
Defensive Abilities evasion, defensive quills, quill shield

OFFENSE

Speed Speed 85 ft.
Melee short sword +20/+15/+10 (1d6+6/19-20)
Ranged quill volley +20 (1d8 piercing)
Special Attacks sudden strike +4d6, quill volley (8/day)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 30, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 8
Base Atk +15; CMB +21, CMD 42
Feats Weapon Finesse, Dodge, Mobility, Spring Attack, Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, Run, Fleet, Nimble Moves
Skills crobatics +35, Climb +24, Perception +20, Stealth +28, Survival +20
Languages Common, Pokweegee
SQ fast movement (+40 ft.), lifelong growth, swift movement, technological wariness

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Defensive Quills (Ex)

The Pokweegee gains a +5 natural armor bonus to AC. As an immediate action when grappled, it can deal 1d4 piercing damage to the creature grappling it.

Quill Volley (Ex)

8/day, 30 ft. range, 1d8 piercing damage.

Sudden Strike (Ex)

The Pokweegee deals an extra 4d6 damage on attacks made after using a bonus feat.

Swift Movement (Ex)

The Pokweegee gains Run as a bonus feat and a +10 foot racial bonus to its base speed when using the Run action.

Technological Wariness

+2 racial bonus on saving throws against technological effects and on Knowledge (engineering) checks to identify technological items or creatures.

Speed Stunts
Accelerated Attack
Moving Target (+3 dodge to AC and Reflex vs ranged attacks after full move)
Powerful Runner (15 ft. push on charge)
Shifty Runner (+2 dodge vs Aoo when moving half speed)

ECOLOGY

Environment any arid
Organization solitary, pair, or enclave (3–8)
Treasure Standard

The Pokweegee Marauder excels at hit-and-run tactics, using its extraordinary speed to stay out of reach while striking vulnerable targets. It typically opens combat with a quill volley to soften up opponents at range. Then, it uses its Accelerated Attack to move in, strike with a Vital Strike enhanced claw attack (potentially adding Sudden Strike damage), and retreat to safety. The Marauder takes full advantage of its Moving Target and Shifty Runner abilities to avoid attacks while maneuvering. Against slower opponents, it employs its Powerful Runner to push them into disadvantageous positions. If cornered, it uses its defensive quills and quill shield to protect itself while looking for an opportunity to escape and resume its mobile assault strategy.
